title: Open current app knowledge from the overview

steps.expected_result: Name, pitch, description, vocabulary, and the other application-level parts are visible or state an explicit gap.

steps.action: Open one feature from the overview navigation.
steps.expected_result: That feature exposes Product, Design, Quality, and Implementation while other features stay collapsed.

steps.action: Retire a vocabulary record and inspect the current reverse index.
steps.expected_result: The retired record remains loadable in history but no longer appears as current naming knowledge.

expected_result: The overview presents purpose and vocabulary, every feature opens its four durable slices, and retired knowledge is omitted from current indexes without losing its record.
